https://github.com/explosion/spaCy/blob/5ace559201c714ab89b3092b87d791e16973f31d/spacy/tokens/span.pyx#L601
Span.char_span() returns a span with empty label, kb_id and vector.

This was missed in #4793

## Info about spaCy

* **spaCy version:** 2.2.4
* **Platform:** Linux-4.19.112+-x86_64-with-Ubuntu-18.04-bionic
* **Python version:** 3.6.9
* **Models:** en

Added the `label`, `kb_id` and `vector` to `doc.char_span()`
Resolves #6815 

### Types of change
Bugfix: passed the `label`, `kb_id` and `vector` arguments to doc.char_span()

+import pytest
+from spacy.lang.en import English
+import numpy as np 
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "sentence, start_idx,end_idx,label", [
+        ('Welcome to Mumbai, my friend',11,17,'GPE')
+    ]
+)
+def test_char_span_label(sentence, start_idx, end_idx, label):
+    nlp = English()
+    doc = nlp(sentence)
+    span = doc[:].char_span(start_idx, end_idx, label=label)
+    assert span.label_ == label
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "sentence, start_idx,end_idx,kb_id", [
+        ('Welcome to Mumbai, my friend',11,17,5)
+    ]
+)
+def test_char_span_kb_id(sentence, start_idx, end_idx, kb_id):
+    nlp = English()
+    doc = nlp(sentence)
+    span = doc[:].char_span(start_idx, end_idx, kb_id=kb_id)
+    assert span.kb_id == kb_id
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "sentence, start_idx,end_idx,vector", [
+        ('Welcome to Mumbai, my friend',11,17,np.array([0.1,0.2,0.3]))
+    ]
+)
+def test_char_span_vector(sentence, start_idx, end_idx, vector):
+    nlp = English()
+    doc = nlp(sentence)
+    span = doc[:].char_span(start_idx, end_idx, vector=vector)
+    assert (span.vector == vector).all()
